Upcoming open FDO Webinar.

On 30.10 at 14.30 CET an FDO Webinar about the FDO Specifications will take place.

Speakers: Sven Bingert, Jana Böhm, Maximilian Inckmann

During the last year, the FDO specifications underwent a major reorganization: from a collection of official notes to one consolidated and harmonized W3C-style specification document. These updated specifications are built on five years of practical experience in creating, managing, and utilizing FDOs across various projects.
